"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/minimum-operations-to-make-a-special-number/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

2844. Minimum Operations to Make a Special Number

You are given a 0-indexed string num representing a non-negative integer.

In one operation, you can pick any digit of num and delete it. Note that if you delete all the digits of num, num becomes 0.

Return the minimum number of operations required to make num special.

An integer x is considered special if it is divisible by 25.

Example 1:

Input: num = "2245047"
Output: 2
Explanation: Delete digits num[5] and num[6]. The resulting number is "22450" which is special since it is divisible by 25.
It can be shown that 2 is the minimum number of operations required to get a special number.

Example 2:

Input: num = "2908305"
Output: 3
Explanation: Delete digits num[3], num[4], and num[6]. The resulting number is "2900" which is special since it is divisible by 25.
It can be shown that 3 is the minimum number of operations required to get a special number.

Example 3:

Input: num = "10"
Output: 1
Explanation: Delete digit num[0]. The resulting number is "0" which is special since it is divisible by 25.
It can be shown that 1 is the minimum number of operations required to get a special number.

Constraints:

    1 <= num.length <= 100
    num only consists of digits '0' through '9'.
    num does not contain any leading zeros.
"""


class Solution:
    def minimumOperations(self, num: str) -> int:
        n = len(num)
        # If already divisible by 25, no operations needed.
        try:
            if int(num) % 25 == 0:
                return 0
        except Exception:
            # fallback, though int conversion should always work for given constraints
            pass

        # Worst case: delete all digits -> 0, cost = n
        ans = n

        # Check for endings that make a number divisible by 25
        targets = ["00", "25", "50", "75"]
        for t in targets:
            a, b = t[0], t[1]
            # find position for b (last digit) from right
            i = n - 1
            while i >= 0 and num[i] != b:
                i -= 1
            if i < 0:
                continue
            # find position for a to the left of i
            j = i - 1
            while j >= 0 and num[j] != a:
                j -= 1
            if j < 0:
                continue
            # deletions needed: delete everything after i, and everything between j and i
            deletions = (n - 1 - i) + (i - j - 1)
            ans = min(ans, deletions)

        # Option: make the number "0" by leaving a single '0' (delete all other digits)
        if "0" in num:
            ans = min(ans, n - 1)

        return ans


sol = Solution()

print(sol.minimumOperations("2245047"))  # 2

assert sol.minimumOperations("2245047") == 2
assert sol.minimumOperations("2908305") == 3
assert sol.minimumOperations("10") == 1

assert sol.minimumOperations("0") == 0
assert sol.minimumOperations("7") == 1
assert sol.minimumOperations("25") == 0
assert sol.minimumOperations("52") == 2
assert sol.minimumOperations("100") == 0
assert sol.minimumOperations("1" + "0" * 99) == 0
assert sol.minimumOperations("1" * 10) == 10
assert sol.minimumOperations("5050505050") == 0
assert sol.minimumOperations("7000001") == 1
assert sol.minimumOperations("5555555") == 7
assert sol.minimumOperations("9876543125") == 0
assert sol.minimumOperations("-25") == 0
